description: List game server sessions with host, ports and connection string. By default only running sessions are returned; pass all=true to include sessions in every status. filter and filterNot match user labels only (the labels given at launch), not system fields such as image or location — use the dedicated parameters for those. Values of the session's environment are never shown.

all.description: Include sessions in every status (default: running sessions only)

filter.description: Only sessions whose user labels match every key=value pair

filterNot.description: Exclude sessions whose user labels match these key=value pairs

playerCountGt.description: Only sessions with more than N players

playerCountLt.description: Only sessions with fewer than N players

name: gameye_list_sessions
title: List sessions
